author: Myworld6
body:
Okay, before I begin I just want to say that this post is not intended to shame anyone - aside from the people who deserve it -It is merely to question some actions by the seniors that I personally disagree with and find to be questionable.

As of now, there are 8 senior moderators on the team, tne greatest amount of seniors that the staff team has had for over a year. Now, I know that most of you will be wondering why this matters. It's quite simple, to be honest:

https://avicus.net/Arigenn

In this case, this senior has not been seen in two months. He has not responded to any notifications, tags, or IP requests. Strangely enough, he still hasn't been demoted. Why is that, I wonder? What could he possibly offer the team if he can't be asked to even check his messages every once in a while? 

Before this is dismissed as being a one-off, I present the case of Javipepe. It took at least 3 months for him to be demoted despite his inactivity, and the excuse that everyone was fed was that he was doing work outside of the server. Correct me if I'm wrong, but work outside of Avicus isn't relevant to the server.

Now, onto the recent promotions. Aside from the complete lack of necessity for the move, what's the point? With all due respect to the former moderators who were promoted, one of them (who I will not name to ensure that it does not come across as me slandering them) was hardly the most genial and professional moderator on the server, nor the best at what he did.

Therefore, I direct this at the seniors and/or the admins: Why have these promotions been given to these two staff members, when the senior moderator staff team is already over-saturated. 

On another note, for the sake of credibility I ask that this be answered by an experienced senior staff member, rather than the ones who have been recently promoted. 

Many thanks, and have a nice day.

title: Slow down...

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
When it comes to inactive staff members it's a lot harder to deal with and you can't just get rid of them.

Being a former staff member you would know that there is a policy and we must follow it. You would also know that you have to be warned in order to be demoted, sometimes more than 1 warning is needed. We must uphold the policy so we have to warn the inactive staff members and give them a bit of time to try and get back on there feet. Only once the warnings happen can we proceed to the next step. This all takes quite a bit of time. On top of that, most inactive staff members have a leave of absence. It's very difficult to demote them straight off when they have a LOA because a staff member has a right to take a leave of absence, as long as it is for a legitimate reason. As for Arigenn we are aware of this and are dealing with him.

As for the new seniors, the senior staff team is going to undergo some changes very soon and there won't be 8 for long so we decided to promote the new seniors, get them trained and settle them in before we do anything to the others. I understand that you may not think they are the right people for the job but I can assure you they'll do a fine job. They have a two week trial period so if they are not able to handle it then we can fix that.

Hopefully that answers your question.
